title: Structure Seedance prompts into labeled sections…
content:
Structure Seedance prompts into labeled sections (STYLE/CINEMATOGRAPHY/LIGHTING/COLOR/CAMERA/MATERIAL/PHYSICS/ACTING) to control different aspects of the generation explicitly.  
Add negative constraints like Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic to prevent unwanted CGI/game looks.  
Specify a fixed color ratio (e.g., 60:30:10 with exact palette roles) to keep consistent color grading across shots.  
Lock continuity by explicitly stating SAME pilot, SAME warship, SAME sky across all cuts and tying story beats across cuts (the warship firing in CUT 1 is the exact one that detonates in CUT 4).  
Define camera behavior with concrete lens/film settings (physical cine lens, 180° shutter motion blur) and movement rules (never static; continuous handheld shake motivated by shockwaves).  
Force multi-shot control by requesting a sequence of N cuts with total duration and aspect ratio (15s / 4 cuts / 16:9) and instructing Cuts only at the specified points; the camera does not cut on its own.  
Specify per-cut shot sizes and optics (MS/WS/CU/EWS) and forbid mid-segment drift (No drift mid-segment) to stabilize framing.  
Write per-cut durations and time effects (e.g., CUT 1 ~3s slow-motion, CUT 2 ~5s real-time, CUT 4 ~4s slow-motion) to control pacing.  
Include physics constraints (gravity/inertia respected; debris mass/tumble; shield ripples on impact; drag on smoke/wreckage) to reduce floaty, unrealistic motion.  
If generating audio, constrain it with diegetic only, NO MUSIC and list specific sound elements to avoid unwanted soundtrack insertion.

es.content:
Estructura los prompts de Seedance en secciones etiquetadas (STYLE/CINEMATOGRAPHY/LIGHTING/COLOR/CAMERA/MATERIAL/PHYSICS/ACTING) para controlar explícitamente distintos aspectos de la generación.  
Añade restricciones negativas como Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic para evitar looks CGI/juego no deseados.  
Especifica una proporción de color fija (por ejemplo, 60:30:10 con roles exactos de la paleta) para mantener una gradación de color consistente entre planos.  
Bloquea la continuidad indicando explícitamente SAME pilot, SAME warship, SAME sky en todos los cortes y vinculando los beats de la historia entre cortes (el warship que dispara en CUT 1 es exactamente el mismo que detona en CUT 4).  
Define el comportamiento de la cámara con ajustes concretos de lente/film (physical cine lens, 180° shutter motion blur) y reglas de movimiento (never static; continuous handheld shake motivated by shockwaves).  
Fuerza el control multishot solicitando una secuencia de N cuts con duración total y relación de aspecto (15s / 4 cuts / 16:9) e indicando Cuts only at the specified points; the camera does not cut on its own.  
Especifica tamaños de plano y ópticas por corte (MS/WS/CU/EWS) y prohíbe la deriva a mitad de segmento (No drift mid-segment) para estabilizar el encuadre.  
Escribe duraciones por corte y efectos temporales (por ejemplo, CUT 1 ~3s slow-motion, CUT 2 ~5s real-time, CUT 4 ~4s slow-motion) para controlar el ritmo.  
Incluye restricciones físicas (gravity/inertia respected; debris mass/tumble; shield ripples on impact; drag on smoke/wreckage) para reducir movimientos flotantes e irreales.  
Si generas audio, constríñelo a diegetic only, NO MUSIC y enumera elementos sonoros específicos para evitar la inserción de una banda sonora no deseada.

fr.content:
Structurez les prompts Seedance en sections étiquetées (STYLE/CINEMATOGRAPHY/LIGHTING/COLOR/CAMERA/MATERIAL/PHYSICS/ACTING) afin de contrôler explicitement différents aspects de la génération.  
Ajoutez des contraintes négatives comme Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic pour éviter les rendus CGI/game indésirables.  
Spécifiez un ratio de couleurs fixe (par ex. 60:30:10 avec des rôles de palette précis) pour conserver un color grading cohérent d’un plan à l’autre.  
Verrouillez la continuité en indiquant explicitement SAME pilot, SAME warship, SAME sky sur tous les cuts et en reliant les beats narratifs entre les cuts (le warship qui tire dans CUT 1 est exactement celui qui explose dans CUT 4).  
Définissez le comportement de la caméra avec des réglages concrets de lentille/film (physical cine lens, 180° shutter motion blur) et des règles de mouvement (never static; continuous handheld shake motivated by shockwaves).  
Imposez un contrôle multi-shot en demandant une séquence de N cuts avec une durée totale et un ratio d’aspect (15s / 4 cuts / 16:9) et en indiquant Cuts only at the specified points; the camera does not cut on its own.  
Précisez, pour chaque cut, les tailles de plan et l’optique (MS/WS/CU/EWS) et interdisez toute dérive au milieu du segment (No drift mid-segment) afin de stabiliser le cadrage.  
Indiquez les durées par cut et les effets temporels (par ex. CUT 1 ~3s slow-motion, CUT 2 ~5s real-time, CUT 4 ~4s slow-motion) pour contrôler le rythme.  
Incluez des contraintes physiques (gravity/inertia respected; debris mass/tumble; shield ripples on impact; drag on smoke/wreckage) afin de réduire les mouvements flottants et irréalistes.  
Si vous générez de l’audio, contraignez-le à diegetic only, NO MUSIC et listez des éléments sonores précis pour éviter l’ajout indésirable d’une bande-son.

ja.content:
Seedanceのpromptは、STYLE/CINEMATOGRAPHY/LIGHTING/COLOR/CAMERA/MATERIAL/PHYSICS/ACTINGのようにラベル付きのセクションに分けて、生成の各要素を明示的に制御します。  
Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic のようなネガティブ制約を追加して、意図しないCGI／ゲーム風の見た目を防ぎます。  
固定のカラーレシオ（例: 60:30:10、各色の役割を明確に指定）を指定して、ショット間で一貫したカラーグレーディングを保ちます。  
SAME pilot、SAME warship、SAME sky をすべてのカットで明示し、ストーリーの展開もカット間で紐づけることで連続性を固定します（CUT 1で砲撃する戦艦は、CUT 4で爆発するその戦艦と完全に同一）。  
具体的なレンズ／フィルム設定（physical cine lens、180° shutter motion blur）と動きのルール（never static; continuous handheld shake motivated by shockwaves）でカメラの挙動を定義します。  
Nカットのシーケンス、総尺、アスペクト比（15s / 4 cuts / 16:9）を指定し、Cuts only at the specified points; the camera does not cut on its own. と指示して、マルチショット制御を強制します。  
各カットごとのショットサイズと光学設定（MS/WS/CU/EWS）を指定し、mid-segment drift を禁止（No drift mid-segment）してフレーミングを安定させます。  
各カットの尺と時間効果（例: CUT 1 ~3s slow-motion、CUT 2 ~5s real-time、CUT 4 ~4s slow-motion）を記述して、テンポを制御します。  
物理法則の制約（gravity/inertia respected; debris mass/tumble; shield ripples on impact; drag on smoke/wreckage）を入れて、浮遊感のある不自然な動きを減らします。  
音声を生成する場合は、diegetic only、NO MUSIC に制限し、不要なサウンドトラックの挿入を避けるために具体的な効果音要素を列挙します。

ko.content:
Seedance 프롬프트를 STYLE/CINEMATOGRAPHY/LIGHTING/COLOR/CAMERA/MATERIAL/PHYSICS/ACTING처럼 라벨이 붙은 섹션으로 구조화해, 생성의 서로 다른 측면을 명시적으로 제어하세요.  
Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic 같은 네거티브 제약을 추가해 원치 않는 CGI/게임풍 비주얼을 방지하세요.  
일관된 색보정을 유지하기 위해 고정된 색상 비율(예: 정확한 팔레트 역할을 포함한 60:30:10)을 지정하세요.  
SAME pilot, SAME warship, SAME sky across all cuts처럼 모든 컷에서 동일한 요소를 명시하고, 스토리 비트도 컷 간에 연결해 연속성을 고정하세요(예: CUT 1에서 발사된 warship이 CUT 4에서 폭발하는 바로 그 warship).  
구체적인 렌즈/필름 설정(physical cine lens, 180° shutter motion blur)과 움직임 규칙(never static; shockwaves에 의해 유발되는 continuous handheld shake)으로 카메라 동작을 정의하세요.  
총 길이와 화면비를 포함해 N개의 컷 시퀀스를 요청하고(15s / 4 cuts / 16:9), 지정된 지점에서만 Cuts 하도록 지시해 멀티샷 제어를 강제하세요. 카메라는 스스로 컷하지 않습니다.  
컷별 샷 사이즈와 광학 설정(MS/WS/CU/EWS)을 지정하고, 중간 구간 드리프트를 금지(No drift mid-segment)해 프레이밍을 안정화하세요.  
컷별 지속 시간과 시간 효과(예: CUT 1 ~3s slow-motion, CUT 2 ~5s real-time, CUT 4 ~4s slow-motion)를 작성해 페이싱을 제어하세요.  
물리 제약(gravity/inertia respected; debris mass/tumble; shield ripples on impact; drag on smoke/wreckage)을 포함해 떠다니는 듯한 비현실적 움직임을 줄이세요.  
오디오를 생성한다면 diegetic only, NO MUSIC으로 제한하고, 원치 않는 사운드트랙 삽입을 막기 위해 구체적인 사운드 요소를 나열하세요.

Defina o comportamento da câmera com configurações concretas de lente/filme (physical cine lens, 180° shutter motion blur) e regras de movimento (never static; continuous handheld shake motivated by shockwaves).

Especifique tamanhos de plano e óptica por corte (MS/WS/CU/EWS) e proíba drift no meio do segmento (No drift mid-segment) para estabilizar o enquadramento.  
Escreva durações por corte e efeitos de tempo (por exemplo, CUT 1 ~3s slow-motion, CUT 2 ~5s real-time, CUT 4 ~4s slow-motion) para controlar o ritmo.  
Inclua restrições físicas (gravity/inertia respected; debris mass/tumble; shield ripples on impact; drag on smoke/wreckage) para reduzir movimentos flutuantes e irreais.

zh.content:
将 Seedance prompts 结构化为带标签的分区（STYLE/CINEMATOGRAPHY/LIGHTING/COLOR/CAMERA/MATERIAL/PHYSICS/ACTING），以便显式控制生成的不同方面。  
添加负向约束，例如 Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic，防止出现不想要的 CGI/游戏风格。  
指定固定的配色比例（例如 60:30:10，并明确各色彩的角色），以保持跨镜头一致的色彩分级。  
通过明确写出 SAME pilot, SAME warship, SAME sky across all cuts，并将各个镜头的剧情节点相互关联（CUT 1 中开火的战舰就是 CUT 4 中爆炸的那一艘），来锁定连续性。  
用具体的镜头/胶片设置来定义 camera behavior（physical cine lens, 180° shutter motion blur）以及运动规则（never static; continuous handheld shake motivated by shockwaves）。  
通过要求一个包含 N 个 cuts 的序列、总时长和画幅比例（15s / 4 cuts / 16:9），并指示只在指定点切镜头；camera 不会自行切换，来强制多镜头控制。  
为每个 cut 指定 shot size 和 optics（MS/WS/CU/EWS），并禁止中段漂移（No drift mid-segment），以稳定构图。  
写明每个 cut 的时长和时间效果（例如 CUT 1 ~3s slow-motion, CUT 2 ~5s real-time, CUT 4 ~4s slow-motion），以控制节奏。  
加入物理约束（gravity/inertia respected; debris mass/tumble; shield ripples on impact; drag on smoke/wreckage），以减少漂浮感和不真实的运动。  
如果生成音频，则用 diegetic only, NO MUSIC 进行约束，并列出具体的声音元素，以避免意外插入配乐。
